sloka: वत्सः श्रेयसि जातस्ते दिष्ट्यासौ तव राघव ।दिष्ट्या पुत्रगुणैर्युक्तो मारीच इव काश्यपः ॥२-२-४९॥
transliteration: vatsaḥ śreyasi jātaste diṣṭyāsau tava rāghava ।diṣṭyā putraguṇairyukto mārīca iva kāśyapaḥ ॥2-2-49॥

translations.english: O son of the Raghus (Dasaratha), because of your good fortune that Rama, endowed with the qualities of an ideal son like Kasyapa to Maricha was born to you for the welfare of this world.
